questions.question: Jonathan swore to do what if his father King Saul planned to harm his friend David?

answers.text: Tell David and send him away safely
Bring David to plead with the king
Stand guard over David's hiding place

questions.question: When Jonathan asked King Saul why David must be put to death, what did Saul do?
Jonathan shot an arrow as a secret signal for David while a boy ran ahead. Where did the arrow land?

answers.text: On this side of the boy

questions.question: When David and Jonathan said goodbye in the field, what did Jonathan tell David?

answers.text: Go in peace because of the oath they swore
Stay hidden here until the danger passes
Come back to the king's table very soon
